name: Choose Longest Emoji
desc:
Emoji names are based on the Unicode names!

Choose the longest emoji! Earn 1 block for each letter in its name. Emoji names are revealed after your selection!

🌋 Each round, rising lava eliminates weaker players.
🏆 The last one standing wins!

By the creator of type or die!
